## What & why

<!-- One or two sentences. Link the backlog block (B#.#) / requirement (FR-#) / journal (J#) / RFC. -->

## Durable state updated (tick or mark N/A — see AGENTS.md)

- [ ] **Backlog** (`docs/backlog.md`) — block ticked/advanced; follow-ups recorded
- [ ] **Journal** (`docs/research-journal/`) — entry added for the block/decision (+ index, LEARNINGS) — _or N/A_
- [ ] **FEATURES** (`docs/FEATURES.md`) — a user-facing capability was shipped/changed/retired, so its entry + status is updated — _or N/A (no user-facing change)_
- [ ] **Requirements** (`docs/requirements.md`) — updated if the spec/scope changed — _or N/A_

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added/updated where code changed, and green
- [ ] Verified on the real host where it needs camera/audio/WASAPI — _or N/A (headless-testable)_
